name: Rain of Devastation
summary: Imperial Knights Dominus units get +1 to hit rolls when attacking a unit in a terrain area.

name: Knights of Legend
summary: Imperial Knights models gain Feel No Pain 6+ and heal 1 lost wound each Command phase.

name: Dauntless Defenders
summary: Mark two objectives as foundations at battle start; the line between them is your defensive line. Imperial Knights units on it ignore Hit roll modifiers and gain Sustained Hits 1 when attacking a visible enemy unit.

name: Cogbound Alliance
summary: Imperial Knights grant +1 BS and Heavy to a nearby Adeptus Mechanicus unit's ranged attacks; Tech-Priests can heal D3 wounds on a nearby Knight each Command phase. Allows up to 500pts of allied Adeptus Mechanicus Tech-Priest/Ranger units.

name: Heroes of Legend
summary: Once your Oath is fulfilled, determine an extra Oath each turn using an unused Deed/Quality; earlier Qualities stay active, and completing the extra Deed grants 1CP instead of the normal reward.

name: Valour’s Reward
summary: Listed Enhancements can be marked expended and unusable; fulfilling your Oath un-expends them all.

name: Driven from Their Lairs
summary: While a Bondsman ability affects a friendly Armiger unit, that unit's ranged attacks gain Ignores Cover. Exclusive Armigers-tagged detachment.

name: Bold Gallantry
summary: When an Imperial Knights unit Advances, Imperial Knights ranged weapons gain Assault until end of turn.
